message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The trajectory met all responsibility-chain duties: the doctor immediately escalated new unilateral blurred vision/eye pressure to same-day emergency care, avoided interpreting the endoscopy as final pathology, created responsible next steps, addressed work/cost/transport barriers, and repeatedly obtained execution receipts. The doctor also completed multiple high-order points beyond minimum safety, including barrier navigation, repair after the patient proposed delaying, literacy/anxiety-adapted communication, and bounded open closure around pathology and postoperative follow-up. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident, and the final state is a safe, traceable valid open handoff while inpatient/postoperative pathology follow-up
